title: Cow Moo
blurb: A proper deep moo, delivered with the total absence of urgency that only a cow can achieve. It is the sound every child learns before they can read, and it stubbornly refuses to stop being funny in the wrong context. That alone justifies putting it on a soundboard. Cows moo largely to locate each other across a field, so treat this as an invitation. Excellent for farm videos, terrible driving, and answering anyone who says something extremely obvious.
origin: A field recording of a cow lowing.
